proves.claim: An item naming a path under another registered board's root is stopped with OTHER_BOARD_ASK naming that board and offering file-there, --after and --here.

cli.add.other-board.asks-with-three-move.why: Without it, a regression that files cross-board work on the wrong board without asking would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: --here with a reason files the item and records the reason as a fact, and --after <board>#<id> files it linked with no ask.

cli.add.other-board.here-and-after-file-.why: Without it, a regression that blocks the two sanctioned answers to the ask would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: On two real local boards, an item naming only its own board paths files with no ask.

cli.add.other-board.own-paths-file-witho.why: Without it, a regression that asks about ordinary own-board items would pass unnoticed.
